encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

div.head: τρόφιμον
div.note: Terent. 2, 2, 58 video erilem filium minórem huc advenire. Donatus non potest Terentius τρόφιμον proprie dicere, et ideo erilem filium dicit. consentaneum est hoc ipso vocabulo usum esse Menandrum. Phot. τρόφιμος· ὁ νεώτερος οἰκοδεσπότης.

Praeterea ad Terent. 3, 4, 1 Donatus bene inventa persona est, cui narret Chaerea, ne unus diu loquatur, ut apud Menandrum. ad 5, 5, 31 quamobrem insigne aliquid fáceret idem Donatus manifestius hoc Menander explicat iam pridem infestum meretrici senem, post corruptum ab ea Phaedriam: nunc demum se inventa occasione vindicaturum.
